title: The Perfection of Religion | Stand Up Comedy by Mohit Morani | Half-hour Special
description:
In this #standupcomedy  video , I talk about travelling abroad, how it feels different from India, my experiences on the road, and the safest things to talk about on stage in India when you don’t want trouble.

Just stories, observations and jokes about things I’ve experienced.
